# OpenCode 工具插件 - 单文件离线安装脚本
# 生成时间: 2026-10-01
# 用法: 将本文件保存为 install.ps1 后以 PowerShell 执行
#   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$Vsix = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'opencode-tool-plugin-0.0.1.vsix'
$ExtDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.vscode\extensions\opencode-tool-plugin-0.0.1'
$Stage  = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('oc-tool-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Stage | Out-Null

Write-FileB64 'extension.js' ''

Write-FileB64 'ncm.js' ''

Write-FileB64 'package.json' ''

Write-FileB64 'readme.md' ''

Write-FileB64 'media/icon.svg' ''

Write-FileB64 'media/miku_dance.gif' ''

Write-FileB64 'media/wowaka,初音ミク - 裏表ラバーズ.mp3' ''

Write-FileB64 'media/电子天使.mp3' ''

function Write-FileB64($rel, $b64) {
  $target = Join-Path $Stage $rel
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $target
  if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($target, [Convert]::FromBase64String($b64))
  Write-Host ('  + ' + $rel)
}

# --- 1. 写入插件文件 ---
Write-Host '[1/3] 写入插件文件...'
$installed = $false
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Vsix) {
  Write-Host '[2/3] 通过 VSIX 安装（推荐，自动处理依赖）...'
  code --install-extension $Vsix --force
  $installed = $true
} else {
  Write-Host '[2/3] VSIX 未找到，改为直接写入扩展目录...'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ExtDir) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ExtDir -Recurse -Force }
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ExtDir | Out-Null
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '*') -Destination $ExtDir -Recurse -Force
}

Write-Host '[3/3] 安装网易云音乐依赖 (NeteaseCloudMusicApi)...'
Push-Location $ExtDir
try {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'node_modules\NeteaseCloudMusicApi')) {
    npm install NeteaseCloudMusicApi --no-audit --no-fund
  } else { Write-Host '  已安装，跳过' }
} catch { Write-Warning ('npm install 失败: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
finally { Pop-Location }

Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '安装完成！请在 VS Code 执行: Developer: Reload Window' -ForegroundColor Green
